core.mv.bg-zoom: Pinch (or scroll) to zoom the background in first, then drag it.
core.morning.title: Morning ayah
core.morning.note: One calm notification each morning with the ayah of the day and its translation. Off unless you turn it on.
core.morning.denied: Notifications are not allowed for Ayah Studio
core.morning.onToast: The ayah of the day will arrive at {time}
core.tour.label: Welcome to Ayah Studio
core.tour.readText: Swipe to turn the pages of the Madinah mushaf. Tap the page for the menu, and listen to a reciter as the words light up.
core.tour.reelText: Long-press an ayah, extend the selection, then Turn into reel: a calm 9:16 video timed to the recitation, made on your device.
core.tour.togetherText: Family circles let parents and grandparents cheer on the children learning their surahs. All optional, and private by default.
core.theme.title: Theme colours
core.theme.note: Pick the gradient that feels like you. It colours the app’s buttons, highlights and progress bars — never the mushaf page, the Quran text or your reels.
core.tafsir.none: No separate tafsir for this ayah; it is explained with the ayat around it.
core.tafsir.failed: Could not load the tafsir — check your connection
core.fav.started: Downloading {name} now. You can follow it here.
core.fav.startedWait: {name} will download on Wi‑Fi, or tap "Download now on mobile data".
core.fav.title: Download {name}?
core.fav.help: Keep this reciter on your phone: listening and reels start at once, even offline. Downloads on Wi‑Fi (or mobile data if you choose), and carries on when you leave the app.
core.fav.sectionHelp: Tap ☆ next to a reciter (Listen tab or the studio) to keep their recitation on this device.
core.pl.others: Not recorded for this surah: tap to listen to their next surah
core.pl.juzHelp: Plays the juz from its first ayah to its last, then stops (or starts again with Repeat · Juz).
core.pl.juzStops: Playing juz {n}: stops at its end
core.pl.reel: Make a reel of this ayah
core.rp.title: Report a problem
core.rp.k.start: Ayah doesn't start at its beginning
core.rp.k.follow: Follow my voice heard me wrong
core.rp.with: Sent with: {what}, the moment in the recording, the app version and device type. Nothing else about you.
core.rp.withApp: Sent with: the screen you are on, the app version and device type. Nothing else about you.
core.rp.thanks: Thank you. Your report was sent.
core.rp.later: You're offline. Your report will be sent when you're back online.
core.pl.follow: Back to the page being recited
core.pl.notHere: {name} has no checked recording of this surah, so {other} plays here
core.night.swipe: Swipe for more of this ayah
core.kids.intro: A calm place for children to listen to and repeat the short surahs. Big text, few buttons, no sign-in, works offline.
core.kids.gateNote: Leaving the Kids space, its settings and anything that leads out of it ask a grown-up to answer a small sum.
core.kids.nameNote: Your child's name — used in greetings and on their keepsake reel. Stays on this device.
core.kids.keptAll: All {n} surahs are kept on this device for {reciter}.
core.kids.kept: {kept} of {n} surahs are kept on this device for {reciter}. A surah is kept once it has played.
core.kids.downloadFailed: {n} surahs could not be downloaded — try again online
core.kids.downloadDone: All short surahs are kept for offline use
core.kids.keepAll: Keep all for offline use (about 40 MB)
core.kids.noneLearned: None yet. "We learned it" at the end of a surah lights its lantern.
core.kids.learnedList: Learned surahs (lit lanterns) — tap to put one out
core.kids.privacy: Everything in the Kids space stays on this device. It never asks to sign in and has no ads.
core.kids.which: Which surah shall we listen to?
core.kids.thriceAria: Each ayah three times (tap to change)
core.kids.needsInternet: This surah needs the internet the first time.
core.kids.loadFailed: The recitation could not be loaded
